what: Validator-Override baseline seeding is documented only in SKILL.md; check-plan-size.sh changes read/emit drift KVs but never write drift-baseline.env when absent
scenario_or_breakage: When Step 2b exits design-postplan-emit with rc 10 (validator defects), plan-size never runs and --snapshot-original baseline write is skipped; Override then runs retained Step 2b.5 via check-plan-size only. With baseline permanently absent the plan sets DRIFT_TRIGGER_FIRED=false, so cumulative drift never fires for that run despite the listed failure mode
suggested_fix: Add write-once seeding to check-plan-size.sh (and check-plan-size.md): after a successful rc 0 size parse, if drift-baseline.env is missing write BASELINE_PLAN_LINES/BASELINE_DIFF_LINES from computed PLAN_LINES/DIFF_LINES under the same [[ ! -f ... ]] guard as design-postplan-emit, then compute drift; add a test-check-plan-size.sh case for validator-Override first parse seeds baseline and second parse can trigger drift
